ev.crisis_turn.title: The Turn
ev.crisis_turn.text: You are {age}. People your age are dying one after another, the children have grown, and your back reminds you of the years every morning. How to live from here - as before, or differently?
ev.crisis_turn.hold_on: Hold on to what you have
ev.crisis_turn.start_over.success: You come out of the turn a different person.
ev.crisis_turn.start_over.failure: The new beginning cost you dearly.
ev.crisis_turn.seek_freedom.failure: The chains hold tighter than you thought.
ev.crisis_turn.hold_on.failure: Holding on took everything you had.
ev.crisis_turn.seek_meaning.success: You found something that matters after all.
diary.crisis.family: The turn of forty: {slot}. Leaned on family - {outcome}.
diary.crisis.home: The turn of forty: {slot}. Pledged the household - {outcome}.
diary.crisis.gamble: The turn of forty: {slot}. Risked it once more - {outcome}.
